name: dealhound
description: Find deals, check sale prices, and compare physical products with retailer research from your agent.

interface.longDescription: Find a solid deal on running socks, compare quiet keyboards, or check whether a product is still on sale. DealHound guides your agent’s retailer research, compares physical products against your needs, and checks whether prices and offers are current. Tell it what you need and share any budget, fit, and buying-country constraints. DealHound can prepare disclosed Amazon.com product links for suitable finds. Other retailers may appear as alternatives. Qualifying purchases through affiliate links may earn us a commission at no extra cost to you. Searches happen on request.
defaultPrompt: Find me a solid deal on good running socks for shopping in the US.
Help me choose a compact MIDI controller under $100 for shopping in the US.
Compare quiet mechanical keyboards under $100 for shopping in the US.

publication.release_notes: Added everyday deal-finding examples and streamlined retailer research when no strict budget or size is required.
